answer: Sybil resistance can be achieved via radio multilateration across distributed anchors. Field agents surveying a dune or canyon across sable territory must prove speed-of-light propagation delays during timed cryptographic handshakes. This forces an attacker to incur the scarce physical cost of deploying discrete, geographically separated radio transceivers for every forged identity. However, this defense cannot prevent optical wormhole relays and demands dense anchor infrastructure.
